subject: gk
question:
Select the correct alternative on the basis of the statements given about ‘Rasa’.

**Statement I: **It is the aesthetic experience that one derives while enjoying an artistic presentation.

**Statement II:** It deals with the creation of human sentiments in the spectator or the aesthete.

options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II is true.
Both Statement I and Statement II are true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Statement I and Statement II are true.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rasa **is a fundamental concept for **performing literature, arts, and visual arts**.
 
• The term is originated from **Sanskrit **meaning **juice or taste or flavour**.
 
• The written text is noted in **Natyashastra **compiled by **Bharat Muni.**
 
• **Bharat Muni **identifies **eight primary Rasas**, **a ninth **was added later.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The concept of "rasa" is about the experience of the spectator or aesthete.
 
• The nine rasa's are:
 
 
• **Shringara (Erotic)**
 
• **Hasya (Humorous)**.
 
• **Raudra (Furious)**.
 
• **Karuṇa (Pathetic)**.
 
• **Bibhatsa (Odious)**.
 
• **Bhayanaka (Terrible)**.
 
• **Veera (Heroic)**.
 
• **Adbhuta (Marvelous)**.
 
• **Santa (Peaceful)**.
 
 
 
• The Rasa is involved in **many Dance **forms such as **Bharatanatyam, Kuchhipuddi**, in **music **such as **classical musical ragas**, in **poetry **such as **narrative techniques**.
